name: Giant Spider (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

items.name: Descend on a Web
items.text: The giant spider moves straight down up to 40 feet, suspended by a web line. It can hang from the web or drop off. The distance it Descends on a Web doesn't count for falling damage. A creature can Strike the web, which has AC 20 and 8 HP. If the web is reduced to 0 HP, the spider falls.

items.name: Giant Spider Venom
items.text: A target damaged by the spider's fangs must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save save or take 1d10 poison damage and gain the Off-Guard condition for 1 round.

items.name: Web Trap
items.text: A creature hit by the giant spider's web Strike gets stuck to the nearest surface. It can't move until it successfully Escapes.

text: Few everyday vermin inspire as much dread as the infamous spider. Giant spiders vary in size. The human-sized versions, sometimes called hunting spiders, are the most common type of giant spider, though not the largest.
